title: Why?
description: NCERT Class 4 English (Marigold): 'Why?'. New words, comprehension, because / so, and a writing task, closed by a chapter test.

nodes.title: New Words
nodes.skill: Read and use the new words from 'Why?': question, reason, wonder, answer.
nodes.teach_focus: What the new words from 'Why?' mean (question, reason, wonder, answer); use one correctly in a short phrase.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses two or more of the chapter's new words correctly.
nodes.bridge_focus: Name just one new word and what it means.

bridge_exercises.sentence: When you ask 'why', you want a ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Uses a new word in context.

bridge_exercises.sentence: To think with curiosity about something is to ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Checks the meaning of a key word.

exemplars: I stayed in because it was raining.
The bell rang, so we went to class.

nodes.title: Read and Understand
nodes.skill: Understand the chapter 'Why?' and answer a simple question about it.
nodes.teach_focus: The main idea and feeling of 'Why?'; answer a who/what/how question about it in one clear sentence.
nodes.success_criteria: Answers a simple question about the chapter in one clear sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Say in one sentence what the chapter is about.

bridge_exercises.sentence: The child in the poem keeps asking lots of ___.
The curious child in the poem keeps asking many ___.

exemplars: I stayed in because it was raining.
The bell rang, so we went to class.

nodes.title: Because / So
nodes.teach_focus: 'because' gives a reason; 'so' gives a result. I stayed home because it rained, so I read a book.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses because / so correctly in a sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Give one example of because / so.

bridge_exercises.sentence: Join with a reason: 'I am happy ___ it is my birthday.'
It was raining, ___ I took an umbrella.
bridge_exercises.context: Produces the grammar point in a sentence.

exemplars: I smiled because it was my birthday.
It rained, so I stayed inside.

nodes.title: Use It: Write a Sentence
nodes.skill: Write one sentence of your own using ideas from 'Why?'.
nodes.teach_focus: Write one clear sentence about 'Why?': who does what, with a capital letter and a full stop.
nodes.success_criteria: One complete sentence on the topic, with a capital and a full stop.

bridge_exercises.sentence: I like school because of my ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Scaffolds writing with a frame to complete.

bridge_exercises.sentence: It was raining, ___ I took an umbrella.
bridge_exercises.context: A second frame to produce the chapter's grammar.

exemplars: I stayed in because it was raining.
The bell rang, so we went to class.

items.prompt: To think with curiosity about something is to ___.
When you ask 'why', you want a ___.
The child in the poem keeps asking lots of ___.
The curious child in the poem keeps asking many ___.
Join with a reason: 'I am happy ___ it is my birthday.'
It was raining, ___ I took an umbrella.
